apply_scope: Every bounded-sample observed graph, every qualification graph, every formal-null graph, and every size3 group within each; not only failed draws. Fixed full-cache controls already completed requested exact IID rejection draws under the same conditional law and remain separately preserved.
algorithm: Uniform integer over all feasible unordered triples; sort D log frequencies, count pair sums for each first rank in O(P^2) via two pointers, cumulative valid triple counts identify first rank, direct integer inverse identifies second/third. Each feasible triple has one integer; iid exact conditional draws.
qualification_unchanged: size2/3 exact iid requested draw coverage; size>=4 same splitRhat<=1.1, ESS>=20, mean initial Jaccard<=.5, initial exact fraction<=.25. No thresholds relaxed.
self_test: 112 target/tolerance tiny exhaustive CDF counts and inverse samples; empirical moments agree with enumeration.
CLI: OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 NUMBA_NUM_THREADS=1 python structure_a.py --mode repair-controls --input STRUCTURE_ORIGINAL --output STRUCTURE_ORIGINAL/triple_counting_repair --watch
dependencies: numpy scipy numba networkx; copy analysis_tools/feature_frequency/core_analysis.py and null_analysis.py; CROSSCODER_EXECUTION_ROOT may point to staged execution root on reserved node. No GPU used.
input_minimal: repair_input_margins.npz, registered_structure_config.json, qualification.json, null_results.json and every frozen observed/qualification/draw group_D.json+summary.json. Large event matrices/checkpoints not required.
